summary: 新西兰天然贝壳杉曾因造船和出口需求被过度砍伐，后来改由人工林中的辐射松支撑多种木制品。国内建筑市场有限，文章据此讨论深加工出口、可再生林木优势和外国产品的竞争。
logic: 天然木材从本地建筑走向出口
过度采伐后转用人工松林
国内建筑与海外市场分工
提高加工深度以增加出口价值
面对国外人工林和替代材料竞争

paragraphs.brief: 在欧洲移民定居新西兰期间，天然木材发挥了主要作用。
sentences: During the settlement of New Zealand by European immigrants, natural timbers played a major role.
在欧洲移民定居新西兰期间，天然木材发挥了主要作用。
Wood was easily accessible and relatively cheap.
木材很容易获得，而且相对便宜。
A tradition of wooden houses arose, supported by the recognition that they were less likely to collapse suddenly during earthquakes, a not-infrequent event in this part of the world.
出现了木屋的传统，并承认在地震期间木屋不易突然倒塌，而地震是世界这一地区的一个非经常事件。
But in addition to demand from the domestic market, there was also demand for forest products from overseas.
但除了国内市场的需求外，还有对海外森林产品的需求。

paragraphs.brief: 早期探险家们认识到，高高、直立的Kauri号干线适合建造帆船。
sentences: Early explorers recognised the suitability of the tall, straight trunks of the kauri for constructing sailing vessels.
早期探险家们认识到，高高、直立的Kauri号干线适合建造帆船。
The kauri is a species of coniferous tree found only in small areas of the southern hemisphere.
高丽树是只存在于南半球小片地区的一种隐形树
So, from the early 1800s, huge amounts of this type of wood were sold to Australia and the UK for that purpose.
从1800年代初期开始，大量此类木材被卖给了澳大利亚和联合王国。

For a period, the forestry industry was the country’s major export earner, but the rate of harvest was unsustainable and, by the beginning of the 20th century, indigenous timber exports were rapidly declining.
在一段时期里，林业是该国的主要出口赚取者，但收获率是不可持续的，到20世纪初，当地木材出口迅速下降。

paragraphs.brief: 从1940年代开始，新建立的称为散热松树的进口树种种植园越来越多地供应木材和其他木材产品。
sentences: From the 1940s, newly established plantations of an imported species of tree called radiata pine supplied timber and other wood products in increasing quantities.
从1940年代开始，新建立的称为散热松树的进口树种种植园越来越多地供应木材和其他木材产品。
By the 1960s, plantation-grown timber was providing most of the country’s sawn-timber needs, especially for construction.
到1960年代，种植的木材是该国大部分锯材需求，特别是建筑需求。
Today, less than two percent of timber is cut from indigenous forests, and almost all of that is used for higher-value end uses such as furniture and fittings.
今天，从土著森林砍伐的木材不到2%，几乎所有木材都用于家具和配件等价值较高的最终用途。
As the pine industry developed, it became apparent that this type of wood was also well suited for many uses.
随着松木工业的发展，这种木材显然也非常适合许多用途。
It makes excellent pulp*, and is frequently used for posts, poles, furnishings and mouldings, particleboard, fibreboard, and for plywood and ‘engineered’ wood products.
它生产出极好的纸浆*，经常用于柱子、杆子、家具和造型、粒子板、纤维板以及胶合板和 " 工程 " 木制品。
Pine by-products are used in the chemical and pharmaceutical industries and residues are consumed for fuel.
松树副产品用于化学和制药工业，残留物用于燃料。
This amazing versatility has encouraged the development of an integrated forest-products industry which is almost unique in the world.
这种惊人的多功能性鼓励了全世界几乎独一无二的综合森林产品产业的发展。

paragraphs.brief: 木材产品的出口商主要针对南亚、东亚和澳大利亚迅速增长的市场。
sentences: Exporters of wood products have largely targeted the rapidly growing markets of South and East Asia and Australia.
木材产品的出口商主要针对南亚、东亚和澳大利亚迅速增长的市场。
Eighty percent of exports by value go to only five markets: Japan, Korea, China, the United States and Australia.
韩国，中国，美国和澳大利亚：“按价值计算，80%的出口只流向五个市场：日本。”
The product mix remains heavily biased towards raw materials, with logs, sawn wood, pulp and paper comprising 75 percent of export value.
产品组合仍然严重偏向原材料，木材、锯木、纸浆和纸张占出口价值的75%。
However, finished wood products such as panels and furniture components are exported to more than 50 countries.
但是，木制品，如板和家具部件出口到50多个国家。

paragraphs.brief: 在新西兰国内，建筑业是实木制品的主要用户，每年约有两万套新住宅开工，这些项目都需要木材。
sentences: In New Zealand itself, the construction industry is the principal user of solid wood products, servicing around 20,000 new-house starts annually.
在新西兰国内，建筑业是实木制品的主要用户，每年约有两万套新住宅开工，这些项目都需要木材。
However, the small size of New Zealand’s population (just over four million), plus its small manufacturing and remanufacturing base, limits the forestry industry’s domestic opportunities.
然而，新西兰人口规模小(略多于400万)，加上其小型制造业和再制造基地，限制了林业的国内资源。
For the last few years local wood consumption has been around only four million cubic metres.
过去几年来，当地木材消耗量只有400万立方米左右。
Accordingly, the development of the export market is the key to the industry’s growth and contribution to the national economy in decades to come.
因此，出口市场的发展是该行业未来几十年增长和对国民经济作出贡献的关键。

paragraphs.brief: 这给该行业带来了重大的营销挑战。
sentences: In 2004, forestry export receipts were about 11 percent of the country’s total export income, their value having increased steadily for ten years, until affected by the exchange fluctuations and shipping costs of recent years.
2004年，林业出口收入约占该国出口总收入的11%，其价值在十年内稳步增长，直到受近年来汇率波动和运输成本的影响为止。
The forestry industry is New Zealand’s third-largest export sector, generating around $3.3 billion annually from logs and processed wood products.
林业是新西兰第三大出口部门，每年从木材和加工木材产品中产生约33亿美元。

But it is generally agreed that it is operating well below its capacity and, with the domestic market already at its peak, almost all of the extra wood produced in future will have to be marketed overseas.
但是，人们普遍同意，它的运作远远低于其能力，而且随着国内市场已经达到顶峰，今后生产的所有额外木材几乎都必须在海外销售。
That presents a major marketing challenge for the industry.
这给该行业带来了重大的营销挑战。

paragraphs.brief: 虽然木材出口将继续为森林所有者提供宝贵的收入，但人们普遍认为，该行业今后必须以增值产品为基础。
sentences: Although the export of logs will continue to provide valuable earnings for forest owners, there is broad acceptance that the industry must be based on value-added products in future.
虽然木材出口将继续为森林所有者提供宝贵的收入，但人们普遍认为，该行业今后必须以增值产品为基础。
So the industry is investigating various processing, infrastructure and investment strategies with a view to increasing the level of local manufacturing before export.
因此，该行业正在调查各种加工、基础设施和投资战略，以期提高出口前的当地制造业水平。

The keys to future success will depend on a variety of factors — better international marketing, product innovation, internationally competitive processing, improved infrastructure and a suitable political, regulatory and investment environment.
今后成功的关键将取决于各种因素——更好的国际营销、产品创新、具有国际竞争力的加工、改进的基础设施以及适当的政治、监管和投资环境。
The industry claims that, given the right conditions, by 2025 the forestry sector could be the country’s biggest export earner, generating $20 billion a year and employing 60,000 people.
该行业声称，在适当的条件下，到2025年，林业将成为该国最大的出口收入，每年产生20亿美元，雇用6万人。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，新西兰并不是拥有种植式林业的唯一国家；智利、巴西、阿根廷、南非和澳大利亚都种植了大量生长迅速的物种(硬木和软木)，在北半球，斯堪的纳维亚国家都扩大了森林或控制了森林的使用，以利今后的生产。
sentences: One competitive advantage that New Zealand has is its ability to source large quantities of softwood from renewable forests.
新西兰具有的一个竞争优势是，它有能力从可再生森林中获取大量软木。

Consumers in several key wood markets are becoming more worried about sustainability, and the industry is supporting the development of national standards as well as the recognition of these internationally.
几个关键木材市场的消费者越来越担心可持续性，该行业正在支持制定国家标准和在国际上承认这些标准。

However, New Zealand is not the only country with a plantation-style forestry industry; Chile, Brazil, Argentina, South Africa and Australia all have extensive plantings of fast-growing species (hardwood and softwood), and in the northern hemisphere, Scandinavian countries have all expanded their forests or controlled their use in the interests of future production.
然而，新西兰并不是拥有种植式林业的唯一国家；智利、巴西、阿根廷、南非和澳大利亚都种植了大量生长迅速的物种(硬木和软木)，在北半球，斯堪的纳维亚国家都扩大了森林或控制了森林的使用，以利今后的生产。

paragraphs.brief: 最后，除了其他木材生产商的竞争之外，新西兰还面临着木材替代品等商品的竞争。
sentences: Finally, in addition to competition from other wood producers, New Zealand faces competition from goods such as wood substitutes.
最后，除了其他木材生产商的竞争之外，新西兰还面临着木材替代品等商品的竞争。
These include steel framing for houses.
其中包括房屋的钢架。
This further underlines the necessity for globally competitive production and marketing strategies.
这进一步突出表明，必须制定具有全球竞争力的生产和营销战略。

items.en: Settlers realised that wooden houses were more dangerous than other types of structure.
items.zh: 定居者意识到木屋比其他类型的建筑更危险。
items.why: 原文说明木结构房屋更不容易倒塌，题干却说“more dangerous”, 与原文相反。

items.en: During the 1800s, New Zealand exported wood for use in boat-building.
items.zh: 在1800年代，新西兰出口木材用于造船。
items.why: 从十九世纪初开始，新西兰就把大量这类木材卖到澳大利亚和英国造船。

items.en: Plantation-grown wood is generally better for construction than native forest wood.
items.zh: 植树造林木通常比原生林木更适合建筑。
items.why: 种植林提供了大部分建筑锯材，说明用量很大，不能说明木材性能优于原生林木材。

items.en: Compared with other types of wood, pine has a narrow range of uses.
items.zh: 与其他类型的木材相比，松树的使用范围狭窄。
items.why: 原文强调松木用途广泛且多样，题干却说“a narrow range of uses”。

items.en: Demand for housing in New Zealand is predicted to fall in the next few years.
items.zh: 新西兰的住房需求预计在未来几年会下降。
items.why: 文中提到“domestic market…at its peak”,但既未预测需求将下降，也未说明会下跌。

items.en: In future, the expansion of New Zealand’s wood industry will depend on its exports.
items.zh: 今后，新西兰木材工业的扩展将取决于其出口。
items.why: 国内木材市场已经饱和，今后新增产量大多要外销，所以林业继续扩张有赖出口。

items.en: Apart from exchange rates, which factor has had a negative impact on New Zealand’s forestry exports?
items.zh: 除了汇率之外，哪一个因素对新西兰的林业出口产生了负面影响？
items.why: 除汇率外，运输成本对出口产生负面影响。

items.en: Which part of New Zealand’s economy does the forestry industry rank third in?
items.zh: 新西兰经济的哪个部分林业部门排在第三位？
items.why: 问题问“经济的哪一部分”,即出口领域。

items.en: According to the New Zealand forestry industry, what could be the size of its workforce by 2025?
items.zh: 根据新西兰林业，到2025年，其劳动力规模可能有多大？

items.en: What kind of timber product is available in large amounts from renewable forests in New Zealand?
items.zh: 新西兰可再生森林提供了何种木材产品？
items.why: 可再生林中大量供应的木材种类。

items.en: Which aspect of timber production are New Zealand’s main customers increasingly concerned about?
items.zh: 新西兰的主要客户越来越关心木材生产中的哪方面？
items.why: 客户越来越关注生产的哪一方面。

items.en: Outside the Southern Hemisphere, who are New Zealand forestry’s main competitors?
items.zh: 在南半球以外，谁是新西兰林业的主要竞争者？
items.why: 南半球之外的主要竞争对手。

items.en: Which group of products is New Zealand’s forestry industry now having to compete with?
items.zh: 新西兰林业现在必须同哪类产品竞争？
items.why: 现在须与之竞争的产品类别。

groups.label: 简答题
groups.instructionsZh: 根据原文简答。每题最多填两个词，可含数字。

pairs: 第 1 段 · 第 4 句
第 3 段 · 第 3 句
points: 原文强调松木用途广泛且多样，题干却说“a narrow range of uses”。
问题问“经济的哪一部分”,即出口领域。
clauses: As the pine industry developed, it became apparent ….
“that this type of wood was also well suited for many uses”补足 became 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 became 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
In 2004, forestry export receipts were about 11 percent of the country’s total export income, their value having increased steadily for ten years, ….
连接词 until 引出“until affected by the exchange fluctuations and shipping costs of recent years”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 until 把这一层关系补进去。
